name: Filomena Ferlaino
bioAdditions: No separate Filomena Ferlaino married to Frank Cognetti can be found. The only child of Leopoldo Ferlaino and Giuseppina Fiorillo in the San Mango d'Aquino baptism registers is Maria Philumena (Filomena), born 8 October 1894 (S1), who matches Helen's age and parents. FamilySearch attaches a sourceless 'Philomena Cognetti' to Frank (S2). This entry is very probably Helen under her baptismal name.

conflicts.siteValue: Second wife of Frank Cognetti, b. abt 1896
conflicts.foundValue: Same person as Helen Ferlaino (I282695503581), baptized Maria Filomena 9 Oct 1894

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Exists only as Helen's alternate name; recommend merging rather than keeping as a separate wife.
